home.title: Admin
home.subtitle: Data quality is the product. Keep the catalogue current and every number traceable.

submissions.title: Price submissions
submissions.text: Verify, approve or reject submitted prices. Anomalies are flagged automatically.

materials.title: Materials & resources
materials.text: Materials, labour and plant with source, date, confidence and verification status.

settings.title: Platform configuration
settings.text: Branding, homepage content, building types and base rates, finishes, packages, extras, locations, estimate classes, financial defaults, workflow and languages. Versioned.

prices.title: Materials & resources
prices.subtitle: Approved material, labour and plant rates with source, date and confidence. Stale = older than 90 days. Submit a price to propose an update; platform admins verify and publish.

submissions.title: Price submissions
submissions.subtitle: Approving a price publishes a new version and supersedes the current approved record for that material and location.
submissions.flaggedHint: Flagged prices deviate more than 25 % from the current approved price. Verify with a second source before approving.

settings.title: Platform configuration
settings.subtitle: Everything the engine, the catalogue and the public pages depend on. Changes take effect for new estimates when you publish a version; existing estimate ids stay reproducible.
settings.contentLanguageHint: Text fields below are edited in this language. A number on a language shows how many texts still lack a translation; English is shown to visitors until one exists.

branding.title: Branding
branding.hint: Shown in the wordmark, the manifest and every report header.

homepage.heroHint: The first thing a visitor reads.
homepage.headline: Headline
homepage.statsHint: Up to four mono figures beside the headline.
homepage.stepsHint: Numbered steps under the estimator (up to six).
homepage.professionalHint: The section addressed to architects, QS and contractors.
homepage.exampleHint: The sample estimate rendered beside the hero.

typologies.title: Building types and base rates
typologies.hint: Base construction rate per m² at Standard finish in the reference location (factor 1.00). Disabled types disappear from the public estimator but existing projects keep working.

finishes.title: Finish levels
finishes.hint: Global multiplier applied to every element unless an element-specific curve exists below.
finishes.curvesHint: Elements whose cost does not follow the global multiplier (e.g. HVAC is absent at Economy).
finishes.blankHint: Leave all four blank to use the global multiplier.

packages.title: Work packages
packages.hint: Share of base construction cost per Level-1 package (Section 5.1). Shares must sum to 100 % — currently {{pct}} %.
packages.sumWarning: Shares sum to {{pct}} %. Publishing is blocked until they sum to 100 % (±2).
packages.phaseNamesHint: Plain-language phase labels shown to clients.

extras.title: Extras
extras.hint: Allowances for optional features. Use one of: fixed amount (× location factor), per bedroom, % of base, or a boost on one element group.

locations.title: Locations and price factors
locations.hint: Factor relative to the reference location (1.00). Disabled locations are hidden from pickers but old projects still resolve.

classes.title: Estimate classes
classes.hint: Labels, range half-width and contingency per class (Section 1.4). Level 1 must never read as a BOQ.

workflow.title: Workflow and data quality
workflow.blockExport: Block professional BOQ export and issue while any price is stale or missing (acceptance criterion 5)
workflow.requireReason: Require a reason for every quantity / rate override
workflow.approveRoles: Roles that may approve and issue BOQs

history.title: Version history
history.hint: Every published version with its note. Estimates record the rules version they were computed with.

publishDialog.title: Publish configuration v{{version}}
publishDialog.text: New estimates will use these rules immediately. Saved estimates keep their rules version and stay reproducible.

resetDialog.title: Reset to factory defaults?
resetDialog.text: All branding, copy, rates and workflow settings return to the shipped defaults as a new version. Previous versions remain in the history.
